Also illegal drug business (非法经营药品) i.e., illegal drug operation without license => illegal drug business (非法经营药品). In Chinese criminal law, the offenses are: "生产、销售假药罪" and "非法经营药品罪". So answer should list both separated by semicolon.

Thus final answer: [罪名]生产、销售假药;非法经营药品<eoa>
